messages.subject: Sequential Deducer dialogs
parts:
Hi all,

Is there a way to write in R a sequence of Deducer dialogs, so that
the selections done in the first one conditions the information shown
in the second, etc.? Or is Java the only way to do this? I'm referring
to something like the 3-steps procedure for "Linear Model" in the
"Analysis" menu, where instead of "Run", the first dialog has a
"Continue" button that leads to a second dialog, and so on.

Thanks
Helios

messages.author: 1a09129d38549286
messages.subject: Re: Sequential Deducer dialogs
parts:
Never mind, I think I have myself found an answer (although probably
not the smartest one). The function called by "run" can create a new
dialog for the following step, and this dialog can be defined
depending on the "state" of the previous one. And if I wanted a third
dialog that uses the state of the first one, etc., I can always add
invisible widgets with that information, isn't it?

If that is correct, then I have a simpler question: how can I change
the label of the "Run" button?

Helios
